name: Ephod
title: Father of Hanniel from the tribe of Manasseh
summary: Ephod was the father of Hanniel, who was appointed as leader of the tribe of Manasseh. Hanniel was tasked with helping to distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes of Israel. Ephod is mentioned briefly in the Bible as part of the genealogy related to the land distribution.

keyEvents.title: Hanniel Appointed Leader for Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Ephod's son Hanniel was appointed by the Lord to represent the tribe of Manasseh in the distribution of the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: God's Command Regarding Land Distribution
keyEvents.description: God gave Moses instructions on who should distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes, and Hanniel, son of Ephod, was among the chosen leaders.

keyEvents.title: The Distribution of Land in Canaan
keyEvents.description: After the Israelites entered Canaan, the land was distributed among the tribes under the leadership of the appointed representatives, including Ephod's son Hanniel.

keyEvents.title: Inheritance of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Manasseh received its portion of the promised land, and Hanniel son of Ephod played a central role in securing the tribe's fair share.
